Why does the back button on my browser redirect me to the page I'm trying to leave at certain news sites and youtube?

Most likely a redirect script. So when you go from Site A to Site B, Site B is actually redirecting you to Site C, which you think is Site B. So when you hit the back button - while on Site C - you're getting sent back to Site B, whose sole purpose is to send you to Site C.
